demonstrates: Reverse-engineered an undocumented game's encrypted protocol from captured traffic, including a container whose subtype byte is scrambled per session and must be identified structurally, and built truth-keeping machinery that has since refuted three of my own conclusions -- including the stated ending of the best session it ever ran.

claims.note: Message types decoded, each pinned to a minimum-length signature. Re-counted 2026-09-12 from MSG_MIN_LENGTHS and unchanged since 2026-08-12; the keys are ord() character literals, so a hex-anchored grep returns zero.
